items.title: Louis Tio Interview, 1960-10-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I always hear Bowling as being a very good cornet player... [INTERVIEWEE] He was. Very powerful.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. Yeah. They had a good band to play that. They had a good band. It wasn't a dollar part of that. They had a good band.
I always hear Bowling as being a very good cornet player in the sense that he was a powerful cornet player.

He was. Very powerful. Another powerful cornet player was this fellow, Manuel Paredes. Manuel Paredes. Manuel Paredes. Manuel Paredes. Manuel Paredes. Manuel Paredes. Manuel Paredes. Manuel Paredes guy had an E flat cornet. Oh yeah. That E flat something. That was played in parade. I remember that. I remember some of that. Of course that was a, that was a cornet bigger than that I believe. But it was tough to blow. Anybody could blow one of them.
